title: Sweep: build report narrative (3 auditor prescriptions amortised)
summary: Build-report narrative fidelity: deriving Changes from the staged diff, POSTHOC resolution, reverted-path disclosure. Caused the wave-3 cycle-1573 rejection. Amortised from 3 content-hash carryoverTodos that were unreachable by any operator directive: their ids were 32-char hashes, so goal-text could never name them and triage could not prioritise them (all 144 were stamped priority=high, which is the same as none being high). Queue audit 2026-08-27. Member prescriptions verbatim below; work them as one sweep, smallest-blast-radius first, and retire the group when the theme is clean.

prescriptions.text: PRESCRIPTION: Anchor the build-report Files changed POSTHOC to the cycle base (git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD) or emit 0 when the cycle authored no commit, so a no-op cycle cannot inherit the prior commit's file count
PRESCRIPTION: Run the POSTHOC 'git diff --stat HEAD' and substitute the result in build-report.md before handoff
PRESCRIPTION: Derive build-report.md's ## Changes from git diff --cached --name-status rather than authored prose, so the table cannot diverge from the commit
